name: New Earth-rise
credit: In the 2026 Artemis test mission, the astronauts recreated the famous "Earthrise" photo. The Earth appears like a 'Cresent Sun', rising from the horizon of the Moon. In reality, this scene is actually 'sideways' and the Earth does not appear to move for anyone on the surface of the Moon. The effect is achieved when the spaceship radially flies by the Moon. The Moon being 'tidally locked' means we only see one side of it from Earth, but that also means that the Earth is always in the same place in the 'sky' for anyone on the surface of the Moon. There's two references to Breakout 71. I know you can see the first, but can you see the second?

author: D.V.

name: Dragonfly
credit: This is a Dragonfly. With very tightly packed large eyes, they have stiff wings and a hard exoskeleton, and their wings are always spread out. Dragonflies are the top predator of mosquitoes. Having an environment suitable for dragonflies reduces the local mosquito population immensely. Sadly, it is nearly impossible to cultivate or raise dragonflies outside the wild. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragonfly?wprov=sfla1
author: D.V.

name: Roach
credit: The humble cockroach. Found everywhere and anywhere. Can survive nearly anything, beheading, getting crushed, lethal doses of radiation etc. Their immune system is one of the strongest in the animal kingdom, hence they can survive in the nastiest environment while carrying deadly diseases. It's very hard to get rid of cockroaches, but it is much easier to prevent them by keeping the our residences free of food waste and crumbs. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cockroach?wprov=sfla1
author: D.V.

name: House Fly
credit: The House Fly. just one of the hundreds of species seen all across the world.. All of them very similar with slight variations. Most Flies actually cannot eat any food, instead, they actually eat the residue and biofilm of bacteria growing on rotting food. So, if a fly is landing on top of food or a surface, you can be sure that it is covered with enough bacteria for them to literally eat it. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Housefly?wprov=sfla1

name: Damsel-fly
credit: This is a Damselfly. Even though it looks similar to a Dragonfly, it is a completely different species with a different evolutionary line. Their eyes are small and far apart, their bodies are softer and they keep their wings tucked when they stay still. Damselflies cannot hunt mosquitoes like dragonflies but they're just as important to the ecosystem and they're very beautiful insects. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Damselfly?wprov=sfla1
